title: A table by the coast
lead: A sacred offering, a mustard-rich gravy, a sweet edge. Follow the food without losing the place it belongs to.
photo_context: Chhena poda photographed in Puri, 2022. This dish photograph does not show Mahaprasad or a reviewed restaurant.
footline: Different dishes. Different stories. Your own appetite.

sections.title: Begin with the meaning of Mahaprasad
sections.text: Mahaprasad is the food offering associated with Lord Jagannath at Puri. Its devotional meaning belongs in the story before any tasting plan. Ask a knowledgeable local about respectful participation and current arrangements; a restaurant meal is not automatically temple Mahaprasad.
sections.question: Ask how the offering is shared and which current access arrangements apply to you.

sections.title: Follow the mustard
sections.text: Incredible India’s Puri guide highlights machha besara: fish cooked in mustard gravy. Use the name as a starting point for a conversation with the cook. Which fish is used? What makes this kitchen’s preparation different? A regional food story does not promise a dish on today’s menu.
sections.question: Confirm the fish, bones, mustard, other ingredients and price before ordering.

sections.title: A coastal curry, on its own terms
sections.text: The same official guide includes chingudi tarkari, a prawn curry. Ask how it is prepared and whether the serving is suitable for the people at your table. You can explore a food tradition without ordering everything it offers.
sections.question: This is a shellfish dish. Discuss dietary requirements and shared preparation surfaces with the kitchen; this guide cannot certify an allergen-free meal.

sections.title: A small piece of chhena poda
sections.text: The Puri guide also points visitors towards chhena poda. Follow its longer story to Nayagarh, then return to the piece in front of you: a browned edge and a softer centre. Ask when it was made and which ingredients were used. It is a dairy sweet; recipes and additions can vary.
sections.question: If you prefer a vegetarian meal, ask about the complete preparation rather than relying on a dish’s name.

closing: Choose a kitchen locally and confirm the menu, ingredients and full price. Tell the cook about allergies or dietary requirements before ordering, including shared utensils where relevant. Keep devotional participation and restaurant dining as separate arrangements. No named kitchen has been inspected here.
